propositions: GitHub-mirrored dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge on GitHub and must be re-landed as Gerrit changes through the normal gate
click 8.2.1 has a command-injection vulnerability (PYSEC-2026-2132) that blocks all changes via the pip-audit CI gate until uv.lock is bumped to ≥8.3.3
PR #123 updates actions/setup-python v6→v7 across 13 workflow files and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish, requiring the pinned-action allowlist echo lines to be updated in parallel

PR #124 upgrades mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1, with mcp v2.0 potentially breaking imports of v1 API paths in mcp_server.py, _mcp_auth.py, and _mcp_models.py

The mcp 2.0 upgrade requires verification that compat shims hold or mechanical fixes suffice; if structural breakage is found, the migration is deferred to a follow-up ticket and only the ruff bump lands
Two out-of-pyproject.toml constraint consumers must remain coherent with the mcp version ceiling: _optionality.yml:105 workflow constraint and ADR 0050 rationale text
